answer_1.quote: In this paper, we design a set of novel diagnostic experiments using automatic and manual re-annotations of two compositional datasets -QASC  and Bamboogle -to control for the different sources of information the LLMs, namely LLaMA 2  and Flan-T5 , might be exploiting in answering compositional questions.
answer_1.outputs: The models generate reasoning steps and final answers for compositional questions, including deductions based on provided facts.

answer_2.quote: We assess performance on the Bamboogle dataset (Section 7 below) using ROUGE-1 , since it deviates from the MCQ format. This metric evaluates the overlap of unigrams between the gold standard answer and the generated response.

answer_4.quote: One of the authors rigorously checked each decomposition to ensure adherence to the transitive rule.
answer_4.guideline: Each decomposition was checked to ensure adherence to the transitive rule (A → B, B → C ⇒ A → C).
